sessions.phase_label: Prototype approach, power selection, and initial engineering deliverables
Mixing, dispensing, component, and BOM design
Enclosure, support base, sanitation, and physical fabrication
Operational testing, plumbing repair, and prototype completion

requirements.title: System Layout and CAD Design
requirements.definition: Provide the physical system layout and CAD or design drawings needed to fabricate and integrate the prototype.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers layout and CAD artifacts only; the parts list and wiring documentation are independently deliverable artifacts.

requirements.title: Component Selection and Bill of Materials
requirements.definition: Select practical prototype components and provide a complete bill of materials, using readily obtainable components where feasible.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers component selection and the BOM artifact, not procurement, reimbursement, or the separate requirement that selected components interface correctly.

requirements.title: Wiring Plan and Electrical Layout
requirements.definition: Provide a wiring plan or overview documenting how the prototype's motors, controls, valves, fans, and power system connect.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the wiring-document deliverable; electrical capacity, power input, and operational switching remain separate product behaviors.

requirements.title: Maintenance and Product Documentation
requirements.definition: Retain and ultimately provide implementation-relevant records such as materials, cleaning procedures, CAD files, BOM data, wiring information, and available exploded views.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the retained documentation set beyond the separately tracked initial CAD, BOM, and wiring-plan deliverables.

requirements.title: Dual Independent Mixing Stations
requirements.definition: Provide two mixing stations that can operate as independent decks and can run simultaneously.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the presence and simultaneous operation of two stations; speed control, mixing output, and dispensing are independently testable behaviors.

requirements.title: Smooth and Frothy Matcha Mixing
requirements.definition: Mix fine matcha powder into a smooth, consistent, well-aerated, and frothy beverage without unacceptable resistance or uneven mixing.
requirements.boundary_note: Defines the beverage-output acceptance behavior; whisk geometry, whisk position, speed range, and splash control are separate mechanisms that can change or fail independently.

requirements.title: Compact Mixing Bowl Capacity and Geometry
requirements.definition: Use relatively small, deep mixing bowls suitable for rapid event cycles and mixing quality rather than the proposed 12-quart vessels.
requirements.boundary_note: Bowl capacity and geometry form one vessel-selection mechanism; quick removal and food-contact material constraints remain separate.

requirements.title: Fine-Powder Whisk Head Design
requirements.definition: Use a whisk head whose size, profile, and material are suitable for fine matcha powder and the selected bowl size.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers whisk-head selection and geometry; attachment removal and operating depth are independently actionable behaviors.

requirements.title: Adjustable Whisk Operating Position
requirements.definition: Set the whisk height and depth to support consistent mixing and foam while limiting load, vibration, and splashing.
requirements.boundary_note: Operating position can be tuned without changing whisk-head selection or its removal mechanism.

requirements.title: Independent Variable-Speed Control
requirements.definition: Provide a dedicated adjustable speed control for each station, supporting slow mixing through higher-speed frothing within the selected motor range.
requirements.boundary_note: Motor maximum speed, controller range, and one control per station are attributes of one speed-control mechanism.

requirements.title: Splash and Mess Control
requirements.definition: Keep mixing operation clean with minimal splashing across the usable speed range, using position, bowl geometry, or a guard when necessary.
requirements.boundary_note: Splash containment has its own acceptance criterion and can fail even when mixing quality and speed adjustment work.

requirements.title: Button-Controlled Dispensing
requirements.definition: Use an open/close dispensing mechanism in which pressing the station control opens the valve and releasing it stops the pour.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers actuation and flow start/stop behavior; pour quality, physical direction, and leak containment are separately testable.

requirements.title: Controlled Pour and Beverage Preservation
requirements.definition: Dispense a smooth, controlled stream without sputtering, explosive release, persistent dripping, or unacceptable loss of matcha consistency and froth.
requirements.boundary_note: Defines dispensing-output quality, excluding valve actuation, spout appearance, and plumbing leak integrity.

requirements.title: Barista-Facing Downward Spout Orientation
requirements.definition: Orient the spouts toward the baristas and direct the stream downward as shown in the accepted rendering.
requirements.boundary_note: Physical direction and user-facing orientation can change independently of flow control and spout styling.

requirements.title: Leak-Free Plumbing and Bowl Seals
requirements.definition: Keep all bowl outlets, fittings, tubing, valves, and seals watertight so liquid does not escape into the base or beneath the machine.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns the distinct leak failure and repair trajectory; sanitation and electrical isolation are related but independently actionable constraints.

requirements.title: Rendered Stainless-Steel Spout Design
requirements.definition: Fabricate custom stainless-steel spouts whose visible form closely resembles the accepted rendering.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers spout material and visible form, not flow quality, direction, removability, or sealing.

requirements.title: Quick Bowl Removal and Swapping
requirements.definition: Allow each bowl to lift out easily and be exchanged rapidly without obstruction from the whisk or motor assembly.
requirements.boundary_note: Bowl handling is independently testable from whisk detachment and spout removal.

requirements.title: Quick Tool-Free Whisk Removal
requirements.definition: Allow the whisk to detach quickly and simply, preferably without tools, for cleaning, swapping, and bowl access.
requirements.boundary_note: The attachment and removal mechanism is separate from whisk geometry and operating depth.

requirements.title: Removable Spout Components
requirements.definition: Make the custom spouts removable so they can be cleaned and serviced away from the machine.
requirements.boundary_note: Tracks physical spout removal, while internal-line sanitation and overall maintenance access remain separate.

requirements.title: Cleanable Liquid Path
requirements.definition: Make bowls, valves, tubing, spouts, and other liquid-contact paths easy to flush or clean without inaccessible spaces that trap residue.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers sanitation of the complete liquid path; removable bowls, whisks, and spouts retain separate Requirements because their mechanisms can evolve independently.

requirements.title: Food-Safe Contact Materials
requirements.definition: Use suitable stainless steel, food-grade silicone, or other appropriate food-safe materials wherever the beverage can make contact.
requirements.boundary_note: Material suitability is an independent safety constraint, not merely an attribute of ease of cleaning.

requirements.title: Liquid and Electrical Isolation
requirements.definition: Keep beverage and cleaning liquids separated from motors, wiring, controllers, and other electrical components.
requirements.boundary_note: Electrical isolation remains required even if visible plumbing leaks are otherwise controlled.

requirements.title: Standard 120V Wall Power
requirements.definition: Power the initial prototype from a standard 120V wall outlet, with internal conversion as needed, rather than requiring battery operation.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the external power-source decision; internal load capacity and user-operated power switching are separate.

requirements.title: User-Operated Power Switching
requirements.definition: Provide an accessible machine power button or switch so startup and shutdown do not require unplugging the unit.
requirements.boundary_note: Functional power switching is separate from the button's visual styling and illumination.

requirements.title: Electrical Load Capacity and Cooling
requirements.definition: Size the power supply, motor controllers, and cooling system to operate both motors, valves, fans, and controls without overload or overheating.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers power and thermal headroom under load, not the external power source or general mechanical durability.

requirements.title: Mechanical and Electrical Component Compatibility
requirements.definition: Ensure the selected motors, shafts, couplings, controllers, power components, and related interfaces are mutually compatible as specified.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the integration acceptance condition for selected components; detailed BOM content and operating performance belong to their respective Requirements.

requirements.title: Stable and Rigid Structure
requirements.definition: Provide a sturdy base, enclosure, and motor-tower structure that resists shifting, rattling, and excessive vibration during operation.
requirements.boundary_note: Structural rigidity and vibration are independently assessable from acoustic noise and long-duration electrical reliability.

requirements.title: Acceptable Operating Noise
requirements.definition: Keep motor, whisk, fan, and enclosure noise low enough that the machine is not excessively loud in event environments.
requirements.boundary_note: Noise has its own event-use acceptance criterion even though available message evidence is sparse.

requirements.title: Repeated and Continuous-Use Reliability
requirements.definition: Operate reliably through repeated event cycles and sustained runs without overheating, leakage, mechanical degradation, or loss of function.
requirements.boundary_note: Defines whole-system durability over time; isolated load capacity, leak integrity, and structural stability remain separate failure domains.

requirements.title: Internal Maintenance and Service Access
requirements.definition: Provide practical access to motors, electronics, plumbing, and other internal components for adjustment, servicing, and replacement.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers access to internal systems, excluding routine sanitation and removable food-contact components.

requirements.title: Practical Enclosure Size and Proportions
requirements.definition: Keep the enclosure and bowl assembly practical for event use without making the machine unnecessarily large, while accommodating required plumbing and controls.
requirements.boundary_note: Physical size and proportions can be accepted or changed independently of decorative styling and structural rigidity.

requirements.title: DJ-Inspired Visual Identity
requirements.definition: Present the machine as a premium, fun, attention-grabbing DJ-turntable-inspired feature suitable for events and social-media viewing.
requirements.boundary_note: Captures the overall visual outcome without absorbing independently changing colors, branding, controls, lighting, or base graphics.

requirements.title: Machine Color and Finish
requirements.definition: Apply the client-selected enclosure colors and finish, including the later beige direction and rendered accent treatment.
requirements.boundary_note: Color and finish changed independently from logos, labels, controls, and lighting.

requirements.title: Elena's Chai Whisk Branded Placard
requirements.definition: Provide the branded placard using the specified Elena's Chai Whisk wording, placement, orientation, and approved rendered design.
requirements.boundary_note: Placard wording and presentation form one branded component; base graphics and control labels are separate visual elements.

requirements.title: DJ-Style Control Labels and Styling
requirements.definition: Style visible buttons, knobs, deck labels, measurement markings, and related controls to resemble the accepted DJ-inspired renderings.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers decorative treatment such as cursive E markings, silver controls, deck labels, and measurement units, not the controls' functional behavior.

requirements.title: Decorative LED Lighting
requirements.definition: Add compatible decorative lighting around selected bowl, control, or base areas to reproduce the visual effect of the reference renderings.
requirements.boundary_note: Lighting requires its own component selection, placement, and lifecycle and can be deferred independently of other aesthetics.

requirements.title: Raised Cup-Clearance Base
requirements.definition: Provide a raised platform beneath the mixer that supports the machine edge-to-edge and creates sufficient clearance for standard 20-ounce cups under the spouts.
requirements.boundary_note: Height, footprint, and cup clearance are attributes of one support structure; its decorative branding is independently changeable.

requirements.title: Support Base Branding and Finish
requirements.definition: Make the separate support base visually consistent with the machine through the selected beige finish, font treatment, logo, and reference-rendered graphics.
requirements.boundary_note: Base graphics and finish changed independently of the base's structural cup-clearance function.

unresolved_candidates.description: Magnetic in-bowl mixing is discussed as an intended future revision, but the evidence does not establish whether it is a current project Requirement or only a possible later V2 concept.

The proposal to replace the current on-off switch with a rendered-style button remains unresolved because the client approves LED work but explicitly requests clarification of the switch-replacement proposal.
